about.title: The work that shaped how I build
about.biography1: My work sits where software development, classroom teaching, and application-security research overlap. This page gives that context without inflating the role I played.
about.biography2: I build web and mobile tools that enter real workflows, and I teach years 4–6 with material designed for the constraints of a school environment.
about.biography3: I also test authentication systems, document their assumptions and limitations, and publish findings that other people can inspect.
about.biography4: If there's something we could work on together — a product, a class, or research — start from the context.

paper.title: Web Application Security Vulnerability Analysis Using Black Box Testing
paper.summary: The study treated the application as an observable attack surface rather than trusting its implementation. Ten scenarios were exercised, with the method and results preserved in a DOI-linked paper.
paper.focusBody: This research examines web application security vulnerabilities using black box testing. City Courier is the context for testing a self-built authentication system.
paper.methodBody: Ten test scenarios are documented in the publication. For results, method details, and research limitations, read the manuscript at the publisher.
